Work on a declared Hamiltonian/BV class with one surviving Darboux clock pair (psi,Q), local gauge differential s, global phase generator R, and H_D=v(Q)Q or the exact action-angle generalization H(Q). Derive the distributional event map O_A(tau)=integral delta(psi-tau)dpsi wedge A for compact local receiver cocycles and prove its local BV closure, representative independence, phase-origin covariance, brackets with Q, H_D and K=D-vR, and composition under changes of clock orientation and primitive lattice basis. Separate lifted-phase boundedness, compact-phase orbital/modulated stability and monotonicity intervals; prove exactly which hypotheses make emitter/receiver ratios phase-origin independent and which fixed-charge reductions destroy the clock. Classify nontriviality as a conditional cohomology statement rather than assuming a receiver class exists. Supply an exact symbolic theorem carrier, a method-distinct verifier, mutations of charge sign, clock orientation, nonclosed receivers and incorrect K/D identification, strict schema, tier receipt, report and atlas fragment. State the selected counterflow fixture only as an instance whose physical nonzero receiver remains dependent on the all-Hodge health audit.
